scope: Target-independent VACE data from coupled-force v7
summary: The final data export binds coupled-force v7, excludes target RGB controls, and uses a robot-only neutral identity image whose independence is measured.
evidence: Twelve training and four validation clips have zero source-frame overlap.
Identity exact-match count over 660 target frames is zero and minimum 16x16 corner MAD is 186.8333.
Controls contain calibrated depth, depth boundaries, persistent centerline, and contact state only.
All source and output assets are hash-bound to the accepted v7 bundle.
lessons: A different file hash is not enough to prove reference independence; target-frame equality and background-region difference must be measured.
limitations: All examples still share one simulated scene.
next_actions: Retrain and evaluate with strict inference and split lineage.
